mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6% signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods where UNRATE > 6.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of 3-month GDPC1 decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 1% signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer demand and earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of 3-month PAYEMS rise > 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98 signals weakening manufacturing activity and earnings pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of 3-month INDPRO < 98 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 900 signals weakening residential investment and consumer confidence, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of 3-month HOUST < 900 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and a sustained 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) jointly signal broad demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of 3-month GDPC1 and HOUST declines (t-test p > 0.05).
